chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Musa (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Abi Abdullah al-Kufi narrated to us, from Musa ibn Imran al-Nakha'i, from his uncle al-Husayn ibn Yazid al-Nawfali, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from his father, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the tradition established in fasting from the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family). He said: Three days in every month: Thursday in the first ten days, Wednesday in the middle ten days, and Thursday in the last ten days. Fasting them is equivalent to fasting the entire year, based on the saying of God, the Exalted: 'He who comes with a good deed shall have ten times the like of it.' Whoever is unable to fast them due to weakness, giving charity of one Dirham is better for him than fasting one day.

key_terms.عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا: Ten times the like of it

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for fasting three specific days a month and what is the alternative for the weak?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this specific Sunnah in *Al-Khisal*, highlighting the Shia emphasis on consistent, moderate worship rather than extreme asceticism. The hadith establishes a precise schedule—Thursday in the first, Wednesday in the middle, and Thursday in the last ten-day periods—grounding the reward calculation in the principle of tenfold recompense. It further offers a practical concession for the weak, elevating the charity of one Dirham above the fasting of a single day, reflecting the juristic balance between physical capability and spiritual devotion.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-209 Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Musa - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Aba Abdullah al-Kufy quoted Musa ibn Imran al-Nakha’ee, on the authority of his uncle Al-Hussein ibn Yazid al-Nawfaly, on the authority of Ali ibn Abi Hamzih on the authority of his father,

“I askedAba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) about the reward for fasting based on the tradition of God’s Prophet (MGB). The Imam (MGB) replied, “All together there are three days in the whole month fasting on which equals fasting the whole year long: the Thursday in the first ten days of the month; the Wednesday in the second ten days and the Thursday in the last ten days. The Honorable the Exalted God said, ‘He that doeth good shall have ten times as much to his credit:…’ Whoever is too weak to fast on these three days can pay one Dirham in charity for each day.”.
